s13.name: Waterous Energy Fund Management Corp.
s13.purpose:
Item 4 of the Schedule 13D is hereby amended to add the following:

On November 8, 2026, the Issuer and Strathcona Resources Ltd. ("Strathcona"), each an Alberta corporation majority owned and controlled by funds managed by Waterous Energy Fund Management Corp. ("WEF Management")
